ctx.x: Now, there was another broadcast that's been put out apparently on the label called Kings Of Jazz. It was recorded in New York here on the 24th of May, 1947. It's got Sidney Bechet, Wild Bill Davidson, George Brunis on trombone and apparently singing, Albert Nicholas on clarinet, James P. Johnson is on piano, Danny Barker is playing the banjo, Pops Foster, and then yourself. The three selections that are on this release include "Wildcat Blues," "Ain't Misbehavin'" and "Blue Turning Gray Over You." Do you remember…
Maybe so, but I don't remember. I don't remember what the (?) at that time...
